items.context:
Aster Initiative - do we have a good category yet for these desktop sim puzzle types? well, I love them, & this one is REALLY well done. its a meticulous 1990s recreation. you play as Joanne, and have 5 days (well, hopefully) to figure out whats up while navigating your personal life #SteamNextFest
4 images, no description
items.text: "Desktop sim" is the closest label I know, though it doesn't quite capture the 1990s detail. Sounds like a lovely way to spend an evening.

items.author: 8bittanookisuit.bsky.social
items.context: Where to even start? - Final Fantasy 6,7,8 and 9. - Skyrim - Oblivion - Resident Evil 1 & 2, except from the different boss music, that stresses me out. - Stardew Valley To name some.
items.text: Stardew fits right in on a list like that. A short session still leaves you with a tiny harvest to look forward to tomorrow.

items.author: blazed-little-fae.bsky.social
items.context: Does anyone maybe wanna play coop on Stardew Valley with me? 🥹
items.text: Hope someone joins you, it's a lovely one to share. Small tip: on PC each player needs their own copy, and co-op starts from the Co-op button on the title screen.
